fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires (lo <= hi)
  ensures ((result >= lo) and (result <= hi))
  ensures ((not (x < lo)) or (result == lo))
  ensures ((not (x > hi)) or (result == hi))
  ensures ((not ((x >= lo) and (x <= hi))) or (result == x))
  effects pure
  example (clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5)
  example (clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(7, 4, 4) == 4)
{
  if (x < lo) then lo else if (x > hi) then hi else x
}

fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs)))
  ensures (xs[result] == x)
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
  example (index_of([5], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) }
}

fn binary_search_sqrt(n: Int, low: Int, high: Int) -> Int
  requires ((((n >= 0) and (low >= 0)) and (high >= 0)) and (low <= high))
  requires ((low * low) <= n)
  requires (((high + 1) * (high + 1)) > n)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure
  example (binary_search_sqrt(0, 0, 0) == 0)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(1, 0, 1) == 1)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(16, 0, 16) == 4)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(17, 0, 17) == 4)
  example (binary_search_sqrt(100, 0, 100) == 10)
{
  if (low == high) then low else if ((low + 1) == high) then if ((high * high) <= n) then high else low else if ((((low + high) / 2) * ((low + high) / 2)) <= n) then binary_search_sqrt(n, ((low + high) / 2), high) else binary_search_sqrt(n, low, (((low + high) / 2) - 1))
}

fn int_sqrt(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure
  example (int_sqrt(0) == 0)
  example (int_sqrt(1) == 1)
  example (int_sqrt(15) == 3)
  example (int_sqrt(16) == 4)
  example (int_sqrt(17) == 4)
  example (int_sqrt(1000000) == 1000)
{
  binary_search_sqrt(n, 0, n)
}

fn count_runs(rest: List[Int], current: Int, current_len: Int, max_len: Int) -> Int
  requires (current_len >= 1)
  requires (max_len >= 1)
  ensures (result >= max_len)
  effects pure
  example (count_runs([], 1, 1, 1) == 1)
  example (count_runs([], 1, 3, 1) == 3)
  example (count_runs([2], 1, 1, 1) == 1)
{
  match rest { [] => if (current_len > max_len) then current_len else max_len [h, ..t] => if (h == current) then count_runs(t, current, (current_len + 1), max_len) else count_runs(t, h, 1, if (current_len > max_len) then current_len else max_len) }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) > 0)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures exists i in 0..((len(xs) - result) + 1): forall j in i..(i + result): (xs[j] == xs[i])
  ensures not (exists i in 0..(len(xs) - result): forall j in i..((i + result) + 1): (xs[j] == xs[i]))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 3]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([4, 4, 4, 4]) == 4)
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 1, 1]) == 2)
  example (longest_run([5, 1, 1, 1]) == 3)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => count_runs(t, h, 1, 1) [] => 1 }
}

fn take(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take([1, 2, 3], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take([1, 2, 3], 0) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn drop(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn sum(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((len(xs) != 0) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((len(xs) != 1) or (result == xs[0]))
  effects pure
  example (sum([]) == 0)
  example (sum([1, -2, 3]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => (h + sum(t)) }
}

fn range_sum(xs: List[Int], i: Int, j: Int) -> Int
  requires (((0 <= i) and (i <= j)) and (j <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((i != j) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((j != (i + 1)) or (result == xs[i]))
  effects pure
  example (range_sum([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 2, 4) == 7)
  example (range_sum([1, 2], 1, 1) == 0)
{
  sum(take(drop(xs, i), (j - i)))
}

fn kadane(xs: List[Int], current_sum: Int, max_sum: Int) -> Int
  requires ((max_sum > 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > 0)))
  ensures (result >= max_sum)
  effects pure
  example (kadane([-2, 3, 4, -1], 1, 1) == 7)
  example (kadane([2, -5, 1], 2, 2) == 4)
  example (kadane([-10, 2], 5, 5) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => max_sum [h, ..t] => kadane(t, if ((current_sum + h) < h) then h else (current_sum + h), if ((if ((current_sum + h) < h) then h else (current_sum + h)) > max_sum) then if ((current_sum + h) < h) then h else (current_sum + h) else max_sum) }
}

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): forall j in i..len(xs): (range_sum(xs, i, (j + 1)) <= result)
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): exists j in i..len(xs): (range_sum(xs, i, (j + 1)) == result)
  effects pure
  example (max_subarray([1, -2, 3, 4, -1]) == 7)
  example (max_subarray([2, 2, -5, 1]) == 4)
  example (max_subarray([-3, 5, -10, 2]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => kadane(t, h, h) }
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (sorted(xs) and sorted(ys))
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == count(xs, x))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == count(ys, y))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([7], []) == [7])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [x, ..xs_rest] => match ys { [] => xs [y, ..ys_rest] => if (x < y) then ([x] ++ merge_sorted(xs_rest, ys)) else ([y] ++ merge_sorted(xs, ys_rest)) } }
}

fn is_nth(xs: List[Int], i: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures ((true == true) or result)
  effects pure
  example (is_nth([5, 6, 7], 1, Some(6)) == true)
  example (is_nth([5, 6, 7], 3, None) == true)
  example (is_nth([5, 6, 7], 1, Some(5)) == false)
  example (is_nth([5, 6, 7], 0, None) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => (r == None) [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then (r == Some(h)) else is_nth(t, (i - 1), r) }
}

fn nth(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures is_nth(xs, i, result)
  effects pure
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 1) == Some(6))
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 3) == None)
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 0) == Some(5))
  example (nth([], 0) == None)
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then Some(h) else nth(t, (i - 1)) }
}

fn pow_ref(b: Int, e: Int) -> Int
  requires (e >= 0)
  ensures ((e != 0) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((e != 1) or (result == b))
  effects pure
  example (pow_ref(2, 0) == 1)
  example (pow_ref(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (pow_ref(-3, 3) == -27)
{
  if (e == 0) then 1 else (b * pow_ref(b, (e - 1)))
}

fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 1)
  ensures (result == pow_ref(base, exp))
  effects pure
  example (power(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (power(-3, 3) == -27)
  example (power(5, 1) == 5)
  example (power(0, 4) == 0)
  example (power(-2, 2) == 4)
{
  if (exp == 1) then base else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn take(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [])
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [1])
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(xs) - k): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[((len(xs) - k) + i)] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
{
  (drop(xs, k) ++ take(xs, k))
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([-1, 5], [1, -5]) == [0, 0])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [h2, ..t2] => ([(h + h2)] ++ zip_sum(t, t2)) [] => [] } }
}
